Essentials 2.0 · Design research · 05-scenarios

Adding scenarios to courses

Semester → Courses → Scenarios. Research into selecting reusable scenarios from institutional and personal libraries, placing them in a course, and managing their sequence and course-specific settings. Scenario authoring is out of scope; events, competencies, learner visibility and Canvas hand-off are neighbouring concerns.

Top examples

30 references · 12 products · Mobbin + Refero. Captured screens and preview frames are evidence of visible interaction only. Flows preserve source order but may omit intermediate steps. This is a focused sample, not a market-wide ranking. Three counter-examples flag task mismatch or an ambiguous captured state, not overall product quality.

  1. Figma · refero:screen-2e0d5f12 Refero — Inspect preview, description and provenance before inserting.
  2. Teachable · mobbin:e8676237-6e24-4e98-90a2-e37bfa82f60a Mobbin — The closest course-native batch-import example.
  3. PandaDoc · mobbin:7833133c-7d81-4179-86a5-6ba8ce80b92c Mobbin — A selection count makes the batch commit explicit.
  4. Figma · refero:flow-5040 Refero — Shows a placed library instance with source identity and configuration.
  5. Circle · mobbin:0489e85e-877c-41fc-92dc-6e6e7bc9c7da Mobbin — Shows whole-section reorder with child lessons preserved.
  6. Mindvalley · mobbin:99d3f73c-a804-4e4d-9b11-132afbe8ab1c Mobbin — Makes time visible across program and lesson views.
  7. Podia · mobbin:6d57146d-b827-45d3-800f-d925dc03c06c Mobbin — Combines guidance with an editable example outline.

What the best apps do differently

  • They separate inspection from commitment. Figma exposes provenance and a precise insertion action; Canva lets alternatives change a persistent preview. For Essentials, preview can be optional while selection remains persistent. Figma · refero:screen-2e0d5f12; Canva · refero:flow-8062
  • They show batch scope before committing. Teachable uses lesson/section checkboxes; PandaDoc names the selected count in its add action. Both show the inserted result, unlike the single-question creation path captured in Circle. Teachable · mobbin:e8676237-6e24-4e98-90a2-e37bfa82f60a; PandaDoc · mobbin:7833133c-7d81-4179-86a5-6ba8ce80b92c; Circle · mobbin:327fbad0-5e87-48c9-b7cf-fb0f5bcce035
  • They make the reuse relationship legible. Figma names the library behind a placed instance; Ditto confirms attachment to a component. These are stronger precedents for source identity than an insertion menu alone. They still do not prove update propagation. Figma · refero:flow-5040; Ditto · mobbin:9d28e0e2-ba12-4eb5-9a77-c3227f36b647; Notion · mobbin:b8778e0e-13d3-49a6-9f01-3680ea66249b
  • They keep structure and status together. Circle visibly moves grouped lessons; Kajabi shows release states within the outline. Sequence and release can be managed nearby while remaining distinct concepts. Circle · mobbin:0489e85e-877c-41fc-92dc-6e6e7bc9c7da; Kajabi · mobbin:5b4497cf-d3c9-445f-bff6-754fbbb1cf7c
  • They preserve useful planning detail in the outline. Mindvalley shows program and lesson time; Udemy puts type and remaining duration on activity rows. This supports showing simulation duration without repeatedly opening each scenario. Mindvalley · mobbin:99d3f73c-a804-4e4d-9b11-132afbe8ab1c; Udemy · mobbin:987d1aea-1d31-4f63-ae58-5989ee6837c7
  • They offer a route out of an empty course. Podia combines guidance and example content; Kajabi supplies an editable structure. Circle’s captured empty scaffold makes the next manual action visible but gives no library-discovery route. Podia · mobbin:6d57146d-b827-45d3-800f-d925dc03c06c; Kajabi · mobbin:8edcefcc-f539-46e6-a13a-d0ed44fa3308; Circle · mobbin:5341f9e1-8516-4a2f-b941-a3ef17a2f63f

Best practices top companies converge on

Actionable recommendations inferred from the named examples in this sample; they are not claims of universal industry consensus.

  • Provide search, source context and an optional detailed preview before adding. Figma · refero:flow-5039; Figma · refero:screen-2e0d5f12; PandaDoc · mobbin:7833133c-7d81-4179-86a5-6ba8ce80b92c
  • Persist multi-selection, show its count, commit once and confirm the destination result. Teachable · mobbin:e8676237-6e24-4e98-90a2-e37bfa82f60a; PandaDoc · mobbin:7833133c-7d81-4179-86a5-6ba8ce80b92c
  • Keep grouping and add controls in the course outline, with visible item/release states. Circle · mobbin:0489e85e-877c-41fc-92dc-6e6e7bc9c7da; Kajabi · mobbin:5b4497cf-d3c9-445f-bff6-754fbbb1cf7c; Teachable · mobbin:e84f7cdf-c9b2-4a3d-bddf-31e53e19e509
  • Show activity duration and type where instructors review the sequence; verify instructor and learner metadata separately. Mindvalley · mobbin:99d3f73c-a804-4e4d-9b11-132afbe8ab1c; Udemy · mobbin:987d1aea-1d31-4f63-ae58-5989ee6837c7
  • Offer an editable starting structure and lightweight guidance, with the reusable library as Essentials’ primary entry action. Podia · mobbin:6d57146d-b827-45d3-800f-d925dc03c06c; Kajabi · mobbin:8edcefcc-f539-46e6-a13a-d0ed44fa3308

Open questions for Essentials 2.0

These are product decisions prompted by gaps in the captured evidence, not inferred platform behavior.

  • Does adding a scenario pin a version, create a copy, or link to a live master? Which course-only settings survive updates, and who approves those updates? Figma and Ditto make identity visible but do not settle propagation. Figma · refero:flow-5040; Ditto · mobbin:9d28e0e2-ba12-4eb5-9a77-c3227f36b647
  • How should duplicate scenarios, unavailable institutional items and partial batch failures behave? The successful Teachable/PandaDoc captures do not establish these cases. Teachable · mobbin:e8676237-6e24-4e98-90a2-e37bfa82f60a; PandaDoc · mobbin:7833133c-7d81-4179-86a5-6ba8ce80b92c
  • Which metadata belongs to the scenario master, which can be overridden for the course, and which is safe to show in the Learner Portal? Duration is evidenced; competency mappings and equipment carry-through are not. Mindvalley · mobbin:99d3f73c-a804-4e4d-9b11-132afbe8ab1c; MasterClass · mobbin:eeaba88c-51dc-44b0-8c15-cf8775b9c361
  • Does course sequence constrain event order or prerequisites, and does adding a scenario create any event at all? Circle demonstrates outline order; Teachable demonstrates release timing. Neither proves a simulation scheduling relationship. Circle · mobbin:0489e85e-877c-41fc-92dc-6e6e7bc9c7da; Teachable · mobbin:e84f7cdf-c9b2-4a3d-bddf-31e53e19e509
  • What reaches Canvas and the Learner Portal: a versioned scenario link, an activity shell, or only event-facing information? The learner outlines show useful hierarchy but no Canvas hand-off or instructor-only debrief separation. Udemy · mobbin:045c215d-6e08-432c-9bb6-3ddd4495fc69; Udemy · mobbin:987d1aea-1d31-4f63-ae58-5989ee6837c7

Coverage limits: this search did not return usable direct Canvas/Moodle scenario-library evidence. Generic library patterns and learner-facing analogues are labeled throughout. All selections remain false for the later converge pass.

Q1

Library browse UX: search, filters (tags, competency, duration), preview before adding

Figma separates finding a reusable item from inspecting and inserting it: Assets search and library filters lead to a Details preview with provenance and “Insert instance” (refero:flow-5039; refero:screen-2e0d5f12). Canva keeps a large preview visible while options change (refero:flow-8062). MasterClass supplies compact category/filter discovery, but in a learner context (mobbin:666b7eaa-84c1-4d32-a152-9b6ae3ae9eb9). For Essentials, combine searchable institutional/own libraries with optional scenario inspection and a persistent selection basket. Competency, duration and equipment filters are proposed domain adaptations, not demonstrated together by this set.

Q2

Multi-select and batch add vs. one at a time

Teachable imports checked lessons from a source course into a destination curriculum (mobbin:e8676237-6e24-4e98-90a2-e37bfa82f60a). PandaDoc makes batch scope explicit with “Add 2 items” and confirms insertion in the document (mobbin:7833133c-7d81-4179-86a5-6ba8ce80b92c). Canva offers a single-design “Copy to course” / “Move” choice (mobbin:4fb0fdd5-431c-4702-9bb5-fbcb4d78c2df). Circle’s one-question authoring flow is a counterexample for this reuse task (mobbin:327fbad0-5e87-48c9-b7cf-fb0f5bcce035). Essentials should let instructors select several known scenarios, review a count, and add them once into a chosen section.

Q3

Instance vs. reference semantics (edits to master propagate? per-course overrides?)

Figma visibly inserts a library instance, identifies its source and offers a variable-mode choice (refero:flow-5040). Ditto explicitly attaches selected text to a named library component and confirms the relationship (mobbin:9d28e0e2-ba12-4eb5-9a77-c3227f36b647). Notion exposes “Synced block,” while Canva shows a choose-and-edit handoff; neither capture establishes later synchronization (mobbin:b8778e0e-13d3-49a6-9f01-3680ea66249b; refero:flow-8062-q3). None of these captures verifies master-update propagation or override survival. Essentials needs an explicit decision on linked version, pinned copy and course-only settings before choosing interaction copy.

Q4

Sequencing after add (drag reorder, grouping into sections, prerequisites between items)

Circle supplies direct before/after evidence of moving a whole section while preserving its lessons and Draft labels (mobbin:0489e85e-877c-41fc-92dc-6e6e7bc9c7da). Kajabi makes grouped content and Draft/Publish/Drip/Lock states visible; Podia shows a delayed section; Teachable exposes date- or enrollment-based section release (mobbin:5b4497cf-d3c9-445f-bff6-754fbbb1cf7c; mobbin:0aed2e1a-0de0-4f32-9dba-2d5a627a1e87; mobbin:e84f7cdf-c9b2-4a3d-bddf-31e53e19e509). The evidence supports in-place grouping and sequence management. It does not demonstrate item-prerequisite configuration. Keep sequence distinct from event scheduling and learner release.

Q5

Metadata carried along (competencies, duration, equipment) and shown in the outline

Mindvalley, MasterClass and Udemy retain activity titles, numbering and duration in learner outlines (mobbin:99d3f73c-a804-4e4d-9b11-132afbe8ab1c; mobbin:eeaba88c-51dc-44b0-8c15-cf8775b9c361; mobbin:987d1aea-1d31-4f63-ae58-5989ee6837c7). These support a scannable outline, but they do not show metadata being copied by an instructor from a master library. For Essentials, duration, competencies and equipment are candidate course-row fields; their provenance, editability and learner visibility remain design decisions. Event links should lead to the Events sub-module rather than imply that adding a scenario schedules it.

Q6

Empty / first-run state and suggestions

Podia reduces first-run uncertainty with lightweight guidance and example content; Kajabi shows an editable starter outline (mobbin:6d57146d-b827-45d3-800f-d925dc03c06c; mobbin:8edcefcc-f539-46e6-a13a-d0ed44fa3308). Teachable offers outline methods and an explained empty course list (refero:screen-4f0eb823; refero:flow-9573-q6). Circle shows an empty section with inline add controls but no library route in the captured state (mobbin:5341f9e1-8516-4a2f-b941-a3ef17a2f63f). Essentials should open with “Browse scenario library,” optional suggested scenarios and clear empty/search-empty states. MasterClass’s captured no-results message coexists with an unrelated course card, making the search state ambiguous (refero:screen-75721406). Suggested items should remain editable and should not silently become scheduled learner activities.
